messages:
infra-bot: :warning: Alert — nodepool "eu1-gpu-shared" showing 18 reserved GPUs with 0 pods scheduled. autoscaler metrics spike.

alex: saw this, cost alarm just fired. any recent rollouts that might have left GPUs reserved? :thinking_face:

mira: nothing obvious in prod rollouts this week. i ran `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep eu1-gpu` — looks like nodes are Ready but no GPU workloads.

jon: paste of `kubectl` output i grabbed:
```
NAME           STATUS   ROLES   AGE   ALLOCATABLE
eu1-gpu-01     Ready    <none> 6d    nvidia.com/gpu=4
eu1-gpu-02     Ready    <none> 6d    nvidia.com/gpu=4
eu1-gpu-03     Ready    <none> 6d    nvidia.com/gpu=4
```

alex: hmm. infra-bot also shows kubelet eviction pressure low, node conditions fine. but scheduled GPU requests are zero in the GPU namespace.

sasha: quick theory — helm pre-delete hook timed out during a previous rollout, nodes were cordoned but not fully drained; autoscaler saw them as healthy and left instances running. seen this pattern before.

mira: confirmed: fluxctl logs show `helm-controller` hook failed for chart `batch-worker` about 8h ago. pre-delete hook timeout. looks like nodes remained cordoned with taint `batch/terminating:true` but pods were not evicted.

jon: immediate remediation plan: 1) drain the affected nodes with `kubectl drain` (ignore-daemonsets), 2) remove node objects so cloud autoscaler can terminate instances, 3) temporarily lower ASG min_size if scale-in blocked.

alex: + add precautionary measure: run a one-off terraform apply to set the affected ASG min_size=0 to force scale-in if the autoscaler is stuck. do it with rollback plan. :lock:

sasha: i'll implement an automated sampler + alert: `nodepool-sampler` that compares allocatable GPUs vs scheduled GPU requests and alerts when idle GPUs >50% for >6h. will also annotate nodes for manual review instead of auto-delete.

mira: also adding a small reconcile hook in gitops for helm pre-delete retries (3x with backoff) — reduces chance of cordon-only leftover.

infra-bot: Cost impact estimate: ~\$3.6k/day if left for 24h (based on eu1 instance types and reserved GPU price).

alex: filing INFRA-1892 for sampler + INFRA-1893 for helm hook retry. putting short remediation runbook steps in the incident channel.

deploy-bot: `kubectl drain eu1-gpu-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` started by mira.

mira: drain completed, node deleted from k8s. triggering terraform plan to temporarily set min_size=0 for that ASG now.

jon: nice. follow-up: add a retro note — why flux/helm didn't retry and whether the pre-delete hook can be made idempotent.

alex: thanks team — keep the thread updated if any other nodes show the same pattern. :thumbsup:
